message.content:
A vertical magazine cover features a large white "TEMPO" title at the top, with "50 Tahun!" written in white script below it. The main headline reads "INTRIK IVERMECTIN" in bold, black block letters. Below this, a block of Indonesian text is printed in black.

The illustration depicts four figures against a textured, light-tan background. On the lower left, a person in a white full-body hazmat suit, mask, and goggles lies on a brown examination table with a metallic frame. They are propped up on one elbow, reaching their right hand toward the right side of the frame. 

Emerging from a dark, circular void on the upper right are three men in white shirts and dark pants. They appear to be struggling or lunging forward. The topmost man wears a black cap. The middle man extends a hand holding a small rectangular box labeled "IVERMECTIN" toward the person on the table. The bottom man also holds a similar box and appears to be shouting. Several light-blue surgical masks float around these three figures. At the bottom right, there is a barcode, a QR code, and date/price information. A solid red border runs along the left and bottom edges.
